_doc: Organization axes for the Western Heart central moveset library (worker 47, 2026-10-22). Controlled vocabularies — every library entry tags exactly one value per axis (plus free-form properties).
input_language: Tekken notation: 1=left punch 2=right punch 3=left kick 4=right kick; f/b/u/d + d/f d/b u/f u/b; throws 1+3 / 2+4; strings 1,2; motions qcf qcb hcf hcb f,f b,b. INPUT-TO-MOVE FIDELITY LAW: press 1 -> left punch, every time.

position.grounded: attacker grounded (vs grounded or vs standing opponent)

properties.comedy-whiff-candidate: canon-flagged: ambitious attempt that may whiff for comedy (Pablo lane) — engine may add whiff frames
properties.dark-finisher: canon-flagged: brutal/disturbed finisher thread (Pablo's Mankind/Abyss side)
properties.finisher-candidate: strong enough to serve as a WH finisher
properties.launch: launcher — puts opponent airborne for juggle

type.counter: reversal / counter triggered by opponent's attack
type.grapple: tie-up / clinch grapple, not a throw yet
type.strike: limb strike — punch, kick, elbow, knee, headbutt
type.throw: throw — opponent leaves their feet because of you
type.transition: movement, dash, sidestep, stance change, evasion
